Package org.apache.juneau.console.widgets

Class ServerValues

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.widgets.ServerValues
All Implemented Interfaces:
Widget
public class ServerValues extends Object implements Widget
A Widget-marked declaration of named server-side scalar values.

This is a thin, typed facade over the existing VarResolver engine — not a second templating language. An author declares named scalar value providers (for example failedCount or lookbackReadable); a widget emitter publishes them into a per-render registry and interpolates their resolved values into widget chrome text (titles / labels) as "$FV{name}" / "$FV{name,default}" at serve time.

Not $W. $FV resolves declared scalar values as plain text (serializer-encoded); it is distinct from $W (HtmlWidgetVar), which emits raw widget HTML. $FV never injects HTML.

Providers must return a scalar (String / Number / Boolean) or null; non-scalar results are rejected at resolve time (no List.toString() join — collection rendering is out of scope here). Values are session-aware: each provider is a Function of the per-render VarResolverSession.

Example:

ServerValues sv = ServerValues.create() .value("failedCount", session -> metrics.failed()) .value("env", session -> "prod"); // Chrome: column title "Failures ($FV{failedCount})" resolves at serve time.

    • values

      public Map<String,ServerValuesValue> values
      Ordered map of interpolation name → value declaration.

      A LinkedHashMap for stable validate() / emit order. This field is Java-only — it is never placed on a @BeanType and never marshals to VIEW_META (lambda providers are not a wire type).
